subject: Please confirm you received "{{listingTitle}}"
title: Confirm receipt of your order
preheader: Let us know that "{{listingTitle}}" arrived so the seller can be paid.
footerNote: Automated message · Please do not reply directly to this email
body:
Hi{{#if firstName}} {{firstName}}{{/if}},

{{#if isFinalReminder}}Your order for "{{listingTitle}}" will be completed automatically soon if you do not confirm receipt.{{else}}Your order for "{{listingTitle}}" should have arrived by now.{{/if}}

Please confirm receipt in your dashboard so we can release payment to the seller. If the item never arrived or something is wrong, open a dispute from the same screen.

{{#if autoReleaseDate}}
If you take no action, the order completes automatically on {{autoReleaseDate}}.
{{/if}}
